class_meanings.stable: Code family is part of the 0.37 foundation envelope. Existing codes keep identity; incompatible renumbering or removal requires migration notes.
class_meanings.provisional: Public and emitted today, but the family may change before a later explicit graduation (aligned with provisional wire/protocol surfaces).
class_meanings.experimental: May change or be removed without a 0.37 stable-foundation compatibility obligation.

notes: Family = alphabetic prefix of a shipped diagnostic code (trailing digits stripped).
PMQTY is provisional while etlantic.quality/1 remains provisional.
ODCS/DTCS/DPCS codes retain their upstream namespaces when present; declare a tier here before shipping new ETLantic-owned families.
